Saved. The skill now covers the U.S. Savings Bonds Sales & Redemptions by Series table — a new table type this question exposed.

Generalizable lessons captured:
- The savings-bond section reports Sales/Redemptions/Outstanding broken out by series (A–E, F, G, H, …) with an authoritative "Total/All series" line.
- "Total sales of all series combined" → read the printed Total, in millions of nominal dollars (no rescaling for millions questions).
- "Arithmetic mean over calendar years" → sum the annual Total values, divide by year count, round at the end. Match calendar-year (not fiscal-year) figures, and don't confuse Sales with Redemptions or Amount outstanding.

No memory update needed — the durable cross-section facts (ESF=billions/thousands, Capital Movements, General Fund/CAGR) are already recorded, and this table-specific procedure belongs in the skill where I put it.
